Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/go.mod https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/docs/security/supply-chain.md#L1-L25 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/docs/security/time-nts.md#L1-L20
crypto_keylength_justification: Artifact and kernel digests are SHA-256 (64 hex characters, checked in code). SSH access accepts only OpenSSH public key types (Ed25519, ECDSA P-256/384/521, security keys, RSA); the project generates no keys, so RSA key length is set by the key the adopter supplies. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/kernel/artifact.go#L212-L228 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/manifest/manifest.go#L152 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/cloudinit/cloudinit.go#L44-L50
crypto_working_justification: The project does not employ broken cryptographic algorithms (such as MD5, SHA-1, DES, or RC4); all artifact digests and checksums enforce SHA-256, and network time uses NTS with TLS 1.3 AEAD ciphers. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/manifest/manifest.go#L152 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/kernel/verify.go#L10-L14 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/docs/security/time-nts.md#L1-L20
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project avoids cryptographic algorithms with known weaknesses, standardizing on SHA-256 for digest verification, TLS 1.3 for Network Time Security, and modern asymmetric key pairs (such as Ed25519) for SSH access. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/kernel/verify.go#L10-L14 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/docs/security/time-nts.md#L1-L20 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/pkg/cloudinit/cloudinit.go#L44-L50
crypto_pfs_justification: As an OS image builder and CLI tool, imago does not implement network key agreement protocols directly; transport-level security in guest images is delegated to chrony NTS (using TLS 1.3 ephemeral Diffie-Hellman / PFS) and HTTPS/SSH runtimes. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/docs/security/time-nts.md#L1-L20 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/imago/blob/main/docs/principles.md
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software stores no user passwords for authentication: generated cloud-init accepts SSH public keys only. crypto_random_justification: Random action identifiers and nonces are generated exclusively using Go's cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator (crypto/rand).
